مُسَبِّبٌ [Reviling much: see its verb. ＝
-A2- And Making, appointing, or preparing, a means, or cause: and causing, or occasioning: and a causer]. مُسَبِّبُ الأَسْبَابِ [The Appointer, or Preparer, of means or causes; or the Causer of causes;] is an epithet applied to God. (S.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
